name: Anthropic Chat
description: Chat with Anthropic Claude models using the native Anthropic API. API key resolved from user's secret store (ANTHROPIC_API_KEY by default; override by passing apiKey explicitly or as 's/<SECRET_NAME>'). Supports system prompts, tools, and structured output.
creator: Covia

messages.description: Chat messages (advanced mode). A user message's content may be a string, or an array of content blocks for vision: [{type:'text', text:'...'}, {type:'image', source:{type:'base64', mediaType:'image/jpeg', data:'...'}}]

apiKey.description: Anthropic API key (resolved from secret store by default — see operation.secretKey)

maxTokens.description: Maximum output tokens for the response (bounds cost/latency; e.g. 1024 for extraction calls). Provider default when omitted.
